bio: In this beautiful quarry-stone building dating from 1832, the Schmah family serve ambitious cuisine that revolves around top-notch ingredients and the seasons – from sole and Aubrac beef to oysters and turbot from Brittany. You can opt to dine à la carte or go for a set menu. In addition to the food, diners can look forward to attentive service in a tasteful setting with a country-house feel. In summer, the gorgeous terrace beckons. In addition, MA PETITE CHAMBRE is a small gourmet haven serving a set menu. They have four well-kept guestrooms for overnight stays....
